title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 3.13 (versions follow prime numbers; 313 after 311): she thinks out loud and never loses what she said. While she looks for her answer, each step of her thinking (what he said, each book she reads, the theme she plays) is a line of her mind's flow and the frame is shown then: by event, never by a clock. When she answers, the steps go and her flow is as it was. All she says after his line is one answer, its pieces joined as they come, its room growing as it does; her panel shows it whole and it scrolls, and while she thinks it shows the answer before, never her draft. Luma stays one being: thinking and her world share one loop, so her world's creatures are still while she thinks. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v3.13: piensa en voz alta y no pierde lo que dijo. Prototipo de investigación.
